reason: The AST port (return / leading comment in a block whose previous sibling is a statement) finds every expected failure in test.ts. It cannot tell whether a blank line separates two sibling statements, because inter-node whitespace is not in the tree and a content regex cannot be tied to the AST node. So returns that already have a blank line before them are FPs. The tsx fixture also has a syntax error (error-tolerant-parse).

evidence.why: `return bar;` preceded by a blank line: correct in TSLint, flagged by the port
